purpose: Visually screened footage for traffic-rule development and prospective manual evaluation. A candidate is not event ground truth or a completed training dataset.
split_policy: Use source_id as the conservative train/validation/test grouping key. Related Dagotel viewpoints and all Jackson Town Square recordings remain grouped. camera_id identifies geometry separately: a shared split group does not authorize reusing camera calibration. Existing held-out files are unchanged.
training_note: The current system uses pretrained detection and deterministic rules. Video collection does not train a violation classifier. Full event labels, normal coverage and per-camera geometry are required before scoring or training.

rejections.reason: 360x240 with embedded central Korean detection overlay; preserve old regression but remove primary recommendation.
360x288 and incomplete stop-line approach; preserve limitation studies and do not market as main training/test samples.
Relevant subject is a motorcycle; outside the project vehicle scope.
Large news marks, replay/hover overlays, short context or camera edits.
Crash footage alone does not establish one of the four configured rules; controlling evidence is incomplete or scene changes occur.
Some are 240p/360p, edited, rain-obscured or lack a visible controlled stop boundary. Preserve discovery records; do not count them as qualified red-light clips.
Several internal edits, monochrome intervals and end cards. Already overlaps the old development sample; not inflated into independent test sources.
Public folder did not expose downloadable files to the connector or anonymous webpage. Not bypassed.
Simulated footage is not real-world violation evidence.
Roundabout lane and priority reasoning has not been validated. Removed at user request.
